# DIO/ODI Reference Model

> Canonical machine-readable reference layer for Digital Identity Optimization (DIO) and Ontology of Digital Identity (ODI), maintained by Daniel Beránek.

## Site entry point

- Top-level Reference Model overview: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/
- Canonical Reference Vocabulary landing page: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/dio-odi/
- Application Mappings index: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/
- Corpus Metadata Registry frontend: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/metadata/
- Semantic Change Feed frontend: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/semantic-change-feed/
- Semantic Change Feed events JSON: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/semantic-change-feed/events.json
- Semantic Change Feed JSON Schema: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/semantic-change-feed/schema.json
- Corpus Metadata Registry technical guide: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/metadata/README.md
- Wider DIO/ODI Hub and publication corpus: https://danielberanek.cz/manifest-dio/

## Referenced research works

- The Crisis of Entity Resolution in Heterogeneous AI Environments: Data, Financial, and Semantic Dimensions — current version 1.1.0: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22416026
  - Zenodo record: https://zenodo.org/records/22416026
  - Version 1.1.0 adds four standalone conceptual visualizations: Identity Collapse, Semantic Fragmentation, Temporal Discontinuity, and Semantic Vulnerability.
  - The primary PDF remains unchanged; the four visualizations are supplementary explanatory models.
  - The work is registered in `metadata/works.json`, cited in `metadata/references.json`, and linked from the Reference Model in `metadata/relations.json`.

## Derived application mappings

Derived mappings are not part of the canonical DIO/ODI Reference Vocabulary. They apply vocabulary concepts to external technical or analytical domains without modifying canonical definitions or relations.

- Application Mappings index: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/
- Application Mapping: DIO Reconstruction Failure Modes × RAG Pipeline: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/rag-pipeline/

  - JSON-LD introduced in: Reference Model v0.3.1

## Agent-facing MCP distribution

- DIO/ODI MCP v0.1.1: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24123229
- MCP Concept DOI (all versions): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24123228
- Public Streamable HTTP endpoint: https://mcp.danielberanek.cz/mcp
- Health endpoint: https://mcp.danielberanek.cz/healthz
- Source repository: https://github.com/dan-beranek/dio-odi-mcp
- Scope: stateless, read-only interface to a bounded Reference Model snapshot and selected derived Agentic ER / Policy-as-Code mappings; not an authorization service or MVDIO Supervisor

## Semantic Change Feed

- Human-readable frontend: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/semantic-change-feed/
- Canonical append-only event feed: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/semantic-change-feed/events.json
- JSON Schema: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/semantic-change-feed/schema.json
- Technical specification: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/semantic-change-feed/README.md
- Purpose: source-backed history of semantic, structural, provenance, mapping, and artifact-state changes; not a Git commit log
- Boundary: does not replace the Reference Vocabulary, Application Mappings, Corpus Metadata Registry, or immutable Reference Model releases
- Feed version: 0.1.4; current live append-only structured history, first published as v0.1.0, with explicit date basis, preserved invariants, impact, provenance, and lineage
- Live JSON Schema version: 0.2.1
- Archived snapshot in Reference Model v0.9.0: feed v0.1.1, schema v0.2.0, 45 events through 9 November 2026
- Live-feed status: operational maintenance after the v0.9.0 archive; these updates do not create a new Reference Model release or alter any archived package

- Current coverage: 50 events; full dated Hub Changelog (25 March–25 October 2026) plus subsequent publication, research-portfolio, archive-reconciliation, MCP deployment/validation, and MCP Zenodo DOI-publication milestones through 11 November 2026

## DIO to DIO research portfolio

- Public portfolio: https://dan-beranek.github.io/dio-to-dio/
- Repository: https://github.com/dan-beranek/dio-to-dio
- Eleven author-led, model-specific analyses of DIO/ODI reconstruction, with different observation snapshots and graph approaches; the reports are not harmonized, ranked, or synthesized.
- The portfolio is a discovery and interpretive corpus, not an authoritative chronology. Verify historical claims against primary publications, release records, registries, and archives.

## Corpus metadata registry

- Registry guide: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/metadata/README.md
- Works registry: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/metadata/works.json
- Relation graph: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/metadata/relations.json
- Canonical references: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/metadata/references.json
- Distribution representations: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/metadata/distributions.json
- Canonical keyword registry: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/metadata/keywords.json
  - Keyword registry version: 2.6.0
  - Grammar version: 2.0.0
  - Status: canonical-approved
  - Work-specific profile: commit-boundary-paper (34 terms; baseline aligned to Zenodo v1 metadata)
  - Work-specific profile: mcp-server (54 terms; approved in registry v2.6.0)
  - Order: C0 Identity → C1 Environments → C2 Work positioning → C3 Mechanics → C4 Semantic Connectome → C5 Failures/robustness → C6 Machine-readable representation
- Zenodo projection for future GitHub releases: repository root `/.zenodo.json`

This registry is an operational metadata layer and does not modify the canonical DIO/ODI Reference Vocabulary.
